packageRules.description: CHUB's own image. A digest pin on our own :latest chases every merge to main forever (9 auto-merged bump PRs in 3 days). The compose example stays on bare :latest; do not pin or update it.

npm 12 refuses to fetch a registry package that declares bundleDependencies (@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi), so lock file maintenance fails with EALLOWREMOTE (npm/cli#9347). Drop this once npm fixes it.
Push CI is path-filtered and never runs on a Renovate branch for .github/workflows or .github/actions, so a status-success gate would hold those PRs forever.
